definitions: Understood and absorbed (information or ideas) into one's mind.
Become absorbed and integrated into a wider society or culture.
Converted (food) into a form that can be incorporated into the body's tissues and organs.
examples: The new students quickly assimilated into the school community.
He assimilated the complex information with ease.
The body assimilated the nutrients from the meal.
Many immigrants assimilated into their new country's culture.
